description: Capability for a detached (pop-out) note window (myne-md/myne#677, epic #173). Bound to the `note-*` label glob (SYNC-1): one host-spawned window per note. A detached window is a split pane in its own OS window, so it is granted the split-pane EDITOR surface, essentially the main window's set, with four deliberate subtractions recorded in decisions and the epic sync-ledger SYNC-12: (1) prefs-WRITE stays main-only, so it gets `prefs:allow-prefs-read` and NO `prefs:allow-set-*` (decision 0136, the one main-window-only reservation NOT reversed, so preference changes flow through the main Settings UI). **That reservation covers a window INVOKING a `plugin:prefs|set-*` command, and nothing else**: the agent's setting write is an in-process call from the agent plugin's own command, so no per-window grant is consulted on it, and the bound on this arm is the client's window-role check rather than this ACL (`decisions/clients/0677`, `threat-model.md` §7); (2) no vault-lifecycle / importer / backup / vault-wide-export / secret-export / clipper / cli-bridge / deep-link / screen-capture (host-applied, #680) / workspace / graph-layout, none of which an editor pane needs; (3) window/webview create + mutation is withheld (the window is host-spawned by #678) except `core:window:allow-destroy` for self-close and reads + start-dragging; (4) the `notes` set withholds `note_delete` + `note_write_batch_transactional` and the `attachments` set is import + reads only, both sidebar/library actions rather than pane-editor actions. The five plugins whose headers reserved themselves main-only (attachments, sync, agent, vault-indices, spell) are updated in the same change to record this grant: a detached `note-*` window runs the same bundled code (same origin, same CSP) and holds the same plaintext a split pane already does, so its exposure is materially the same as a split pane's, which is already permitted. The agent grant resolves because its ACL namespace is declared unconditionally in build.rs (myne-md/myne#715); the plugin itself stays feature-gated. omerdduran reviews the reservation resolution in the PR. Keys never cross IPC.
